scope: Historical 2026-10-24 product FFI normal/build snapshot for three MSVC targets, including bounded Math, NativeFlowchartV1 and host proc macros. Its checked_on, lockfile hash, target_closures, package versions, features and notice hashes describe that captured graph. Current graph identity comes from active Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock and vendor/forks.json; current notice coverage combines this preserved snapshot with NativeSvg/dependency-notices.json and NativeSvg/supplemental-inventory.json. Dev-only comparison renderer/Dugong excluded. Inventory membership is not runtime or platform qualification.
metadata_command: cargo metadata --locked --format-version 1 --filter-platform <target>; normal/build traversal from notepads-markdown-ffi
